    G

    GameEngine - Class in org.openjfx.engine
    GameEngine handles the core of the game and the matches.
    GameEngine(GameState, GameMode, GameView, MatchSettings) - Constructor for class org.openjfx.engine.GameEngine
    Sole constructor which initializes the engine with the required core components, specifies the settings and initializes a new tracking instance for the global statistics.
    GameMode - Interface in org.openjfx.model
    Defines the strategy for determining when a match is officially over.
    GameState - Class in org.openjfx.model
    Contains the current state of an ongoing match.
    It remembers the players, their position and the direction of the match (clockwise or not).
    It also initializes the deck, shuffles it, tracks its lifecycle with the discard pile (which can be turned into a new deck) and manages any interaction with the deck.
    The statistics of the match are registered by MatchStats
    GameState(List, MatchSettings) - Constructor for class org.openjfx.model.GameState
    Sole constructor, sets up the state of the game ready to function and establishes the players
    GameStats - Class in org.openjfx.model
    Collects, aggregates, and calculates global statistics for all matches ever played in the game.
    This class tracks data such as total penalties, total challenges, and calculated averages for scores, rounds and turns.
